question:
Batch 37 cycle 2 = RULING 23 (orchestrator 2026-11-12 '13:18') in the REVIEW DROP (telegram.review_drop: an engineering review of a run that is NOT a pass, labelled 'REVIEW ONLY - NOT A PASS - not for publishing'; the release path is unchanged). V1 (the visual checklist answered by two vision models) used to make a run never droppable. Now a failing V1 row is droppable ONLY when every failing V1 item (checklist rows per model, letterbox shots, boundary pairs, from VERIFY/VERIFICATION.json) is a SPLIT: at least one model 'yes' and every other model an explicit 'no'; both 'no', a missing / other answer, fewer than two models, an unreadable file, or a failing credits_round_and_match while the measured ring geometry row G15_credits is not PASS: refused (nothing sent). A droppable split is quoted in the note: the item, each model's answer and reason. Also: the forbidden-wording check is now case-insensitive (cycle 1 consensus F2).
FIND: any way a V1 failure on which both models said no, or a ring-geometry failure, is dropped; any way a split is dropped without being quoted; tests that do not test what they claim. Reply with the JSON verdict; keep the reasoning short; at most 3 findings.

rejected_findings.issue: A V1 row that is not PASS in GATE_REPORT but has no failing items in VERIFICATION.json (all per-model rows ok=True, no failing letterbox/boundary entries) and visual.ok is True is returned as droppable with an empty description. No split is quoted, violating the ruling that 'A droppable split is quoted in the note: the item, each model's answer and reason.' The guard only refuses when failing is empty AND vis.ok is not True; when vis.ok IS True it falls through to return (True, '').
rejected_findings.evidence:
if not failing and vis.get("ok") is not True:
        return False, "V1 failed with no item that can be read"
rejected_findings.fix: Remove the vis.get('ok') condition so that an empty failing set always refuses: `if not failing: return False, 'V1 failed with no item that can be read'`. Alternatively, after the for-loop, add `if not desc: return False, 'no split to quote'` before the return True.

rejected_findings.issue: Letterbox shots and boundary pairs are stored with ok hardcoded to False for every model, so the split check (which requires at least one model with ok=True) can never recognise a valid split on these items. The ruling explicitly lists 'letterbox shots, boundary pairs' as V1 items eligible for split-dropping. A genuine one-yes-one-no split on a letterbox shot is incorrectly refused, and more critically, the per-model ok status from the verification data is discarded, making the item's answers untrustworthy for any downstream logic.
rejected_findings.evidence: items[(part, name)] = {m: (False, str(a), "") for m, a in (e.get("answers") or {}).items()}
rejected_findings.fix: Preserve the per-model ok flag from the verification data instead of hardcoding False. For example, if the answers dict maps model→{ok, answer, why}, use those values; if it maps model→answer-string, derive ok from the answer text (e.g., ok = a.strip().lower() == 'yes').

missed_in_cycle2_unvoted.issue: Missing per-item answers are not detected: if one model lacks a row and the other's ok is True, the item is not in failing, so a V1 failure with a missing answer can be dropped.
missed_in_cycle2_unvoted.evidence: failing = {k: v for k, v in items.items() if not all(ok for ok, _, _ in v.values())}
missed_in_cycle2_unvoted.fix: Require every model to have an answer for every item; if any model is missing, refuse.

missed_in_cycle2_unvoted.issue: Split check uses ok boolean for yes instead of verifying answer is 'yes'; a model with ok=True but answer 'no' is counted as yes, allowing a both-no item to be dropped.
missed_in_cycle2_unvoted.evidence: yes = [m for m, (ok, a, _) in ans.items() if ok]

missed_in_cycle2_unvoted.issue: Reason is omitted from the quoted split when empty; ruling requires each model's answer and reason.
missed_in_cycle2_unvoted.fix: Always include the reason field, even if empty, or refuse if reason is missing.
